roster.title: The Roster
roster.intro: Every ingredient on the counter, live. Hover a card — or tab to it — and watch it swing.
howto.title: How a Run Plays
howto.intro: Five steps. Read only the headings and you already know the game.
howto.step1.heading: Buy from the stall
howto.step1.body: The shop restocks every round. Ingredients cost between 2 and 5 — spend what you can afford.
howto.step2.heading: Place your board
howto.step2.body: Set your ingredients on the hex grid before the round starts. Position is half the fight.
howto.step3.heading: Merge two into one
howto.step3.body: Two matching ingredients merge into a stronger one. Merging is the whole economy.
howto.step4.heading: Let the round cook itself
howto.step4.body: No input during the fight — it plays out on its own, board against board.
howto.step5.heading: Climb the standings
howto.step5.body: Win rounds, keep your board standing, and outlast the table.
howto.step1.alt: The in-game shop, showing ingredients available to buy this round
howto.step2.alt: The hex board mid-placement, with units set into position before the round starts
howto.step3.alt: Two matching ingredients merging into one stronger unit
howto.step4.alt: A fight mid-swing between two boards, playing out with no player input
howto.step5.alt: The end-of-run standings, ranking every seat at the table
art.title: The Art We Didn't Ship
art.intro: Before the counter and the awning, six other directions were tried. Here they are — including the one that named the studio.
art.style.defter.name: Defter
art.style.defter.note: A hand-ruled ledger page — cream paper, pencil-thin hex lines, nothing painted.
art.style.defter.alt: Defter, an early Kitchen Tactics art direction
art.style.cini.name: Çini
art.style.cini.note: Deep indigo and white, bordered like Iznik tilework — handsome, but reads as decor before it reads as a game.
art.style.cini.alt: Çini, an early Kitchen Tactics art direction
art.style.pazar.name: Pazar
art.style.pazar.note: The striped market awning first appears here — the motif that survived even though the counter underneath did not.
art.style.pazar.alt: Pazar, an early Kitchen Tactics art direction
art.style.buzdolabi.name: Buzdolabı
art.style.buzdolabi.note: Steel-blue and frosted, a refrigerator door's worth of magnets — too cold for a food fight.
art.style.buzdolabi.alt: Buzdolabı, an early Kitchen Tactics art direction
art.style.tezgah.name: Tezgah
art.style.tezgah.note: Warm plank counter, worn brass — the direction that named the studio and shipped as the board itself.
art.style.tezgah.alt: Tezgah, the chosen Kitchen Tactics art direction
art.style.ocak.name: Ocak
art.style.ocak.note: Charcoal and ember glow, a cooktop grate for a board — striking, but every card fights the dark for attention.
art.style.ocak.alt: Ocak, an early Kitchen Tactics art direction
art.style.neon.name: Neon
art.style.neon.note: Synthwave arcade cabinet, glowing grid lines — a different game's clothes on this one's roster.
art.style.neon.alt: Neon, an early Kitchen Tactics art direction
